comments.text: Browser cascade audit found that CardShell caller inline default borders override the DS hover border; removed those overrides and reused the shell border contract. Also found the existing native select background SVG remains black in dark mode. Added an opt-in form.css native-chevron modifier, scoped to migrated native selects; this preserves the same native control, values, events and disabled options while allowing the browser to render a contrasting arrow via color-scheme. No global token or button CSS changes.
